Jack Lowden's Return to 'Slow Horses' Sets Sparks Speculation Over James Bond Prospects

Casting Speculation Continues

Recent reports indicate that Scottish actor Jack Lowden has been spotted filming the eighth season of the Apple TV+ spy drama *Slow Horses*. The footage, which reportedly features Lowden performing scenes in east London, follows shortly after the conclusion of the series' sixth season.

Implications for the 007 Role

For some time, Lowden has been frequently mentioned in public speculation as a potential successor to Daniel Craig for the role of James Bond. Because the production schedule for a high-profile series like *Slow Horses* requires a significant time commitment, some observers have questioned whether Lowden’s continued involvement in the show complicates his availability for the long-running 007 franchise.

Plot Context

The timing of this filming activity is notable given the narrative trajectory of Lowden’s character, River Cartwright. Following a cliffhanger in the season six finale—in which the character faced a medical emergency after exposure to a nerve agent—the production photos suggest the character remains a central part of the upcoming narrative arc.

Status of the Bond Search

While fans and commentators continue to debate potential candidates for the next Bond film, currently being developed by Amazon MGM Studios, no official casting decisions have been confirmed by the studio. Among other actors frequently mentioned in industry reports as potential contenders are:

  • Callum Turner
  • Josh O'Connor

It is important to note that these names remain part of widespread industry gossip rather than verified casting announcements from the studio or the production team. Prospective viewers can verify future developments regarding the James Bond franchise by monitoring official statements released through Amazon MGM Studios' press channels or authorized entertainment trade publications.
